ImageDescription.value: The Aztec god, Xiuhtecuhtli, as one of the nine Lords of the Night, on page 14 of the Codex Borgia, with an offering of a rubber ball, a quetzal feather and a bundle of sticks (see The Codex Borgia : A Full-Color Restoration of the Ancient Mexican Manuscript by Gisele Díaz and Alan Rodgers, 2013, p.XIX).
